apanata：apanata（ti）
အပနတ（တိ）
[apa+namu+ta. apa+nata]
[အပ+နမု+တ။ အပ+နတ]
P: Apanata，[pp. of apanamati] “bent away”，drawn aside，in ster. comb<sup>n.</sup> abhinata + apanata （“strained forth & strained aside” Mrs Rh. D. Kindred S. p. 39） M.I，386； S.I，28. （Page 51）
K:
apanata：＂အပနတ（တိ）
[အပ+နမု+တ။ အပ+နတ]
（၁） ဒေါသ၏ အစွမ်းဖြင့်-ကြဉ်ဖယ်-မျက်နှာလွဲ-သော၊ ထိပါး-ပြစ်မှား-သော၊ ညွတ်ခြင်း-ငြိကပ်ခြင်း-ကင်းသော။ အနပနတ-လည်းကြည့်။ （၂） ခုံး-မောက်-သော။ （က） တက်ကြွ-ပျံ့လွင့်-သော။
R:
apanata：အပ-နတ（တိ） （တီ-ကိတ်） （အပ√နမ်+တ）
ဖဲအပ်သည်။
DOP: apanamati pr. 3 sg. [ S. apa√nam], bends away, bends down; goes away ; Sn 1101 (sutvāna nāgassa ~issanti ito; Nidd II 89, 5 : vajissanti pakkamissanti; Pj II 599, 4 : bahū janā pakkamissantī ti adhippāyo); Sp 85, 8 (chattam ~atu, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr apanetu); — aor. 3 sg. apanami, Sp 85, 10 (saha rañño cittuppādena chattam ~i); — pp apanata ( and apaṇata), mfn. [ ts ], bent away; disinclined, averse ; M I 386, 22* (satīmato vipassissa anabhinatassa no ~assa; Ps III 98, 15 : no ~assā ti aduṭṭhassa); S I 28, 32 (cittaṃ … na cābhinataṃ na cāpanataṃ; Spk I 80, 24 : dosānugataṃ ~aṃ); A IV 428, 4 (samādhi na cābhinato na cāpanato); — neg. anapanata, mfn. , Paṭis II 206, 17 (apanataṃ cittaṃ vyāpāde na iñjatī ti) quoted Vism 386, 14 ( Be, Ce so; Ee, Se wr anupanataṃ) = Ud-a 186, 4 ( Be, Se so; Ee wr an-upanataṃ; Ce anabhirataṃ); — caus. 3 sg. apanāmeti , makes bend down, lowers; turns away (trans.); takes away, removes ; Vin I 303, 12 (asappāyaṃ upanāmeti sappāyaṃ ~eti); D I 126, 12 (hatthaṃ ~eyyaṃ); M I 96, 4 (bahiddhā kathaṃ ~eti; Ps II 66, 28 : kathaṃ bahiddhā vikkhipati); A I 187, 6 (~essati); Khp 8:4 (nāgā vā ~enti); — part.pr. apanāmenta, mfn. , Sv 184, 3 (pacchato ~ento paṭikkamati nāma); — aor. 3 sg. apanāmesi, Sn p. 48, 7 (bhagavā kāyaṃ ~esi); — absol. apanāmetvā, Vin II 208, 1 (chattaṃ ~etvā sīsaṃ vivaritvā); Sp 329, 17 ; — pp neg. anapanāmita, mfn. , not removed ; Sp 829, 17 (anuccāritakatan ti … īsakaṃ pi anukkhittaṃ vā anapanāmitaṃ vā kataṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so, perhaps wr; Se anupanāmitaṃ).
CPD: apa-nata , mfn. ( pp. of apa-namati), bent away, disinclined ( opp. abhinata); AN lV 428, 4 (samādhi na câbhinato na câpanato; = dosavasena na apanato, Mp); SN l 28, 32 (cittaṃ . . . na câbhinataṃ na câpa- nataṃ; — dosânugataṃ, Spk); Paṭis 1165, 15 = 167, 8 (~aṃ cittaṃ vyāpādânupatitaṃ; here written apa- ṇataṃ); MN l 386, 22 * (satīmato vipassissa anabhina- apa-nata
NCP: pp. mfn. bent away; disinclined, averse See also: apanamati

apāṇātipāta.p: [Na+pāṇātipāta] (pu) CL=9 Not taking off the life faculty quickly, not killing living being.
a: အပါဏာတိပါတ(ပု)
ဇီဝိတိန္ဒြေကို လျင်စွာ မချခြင်း၊ သတ္တဝါကို မသတ်ခြင်း။
